title: Vessels study step S6: NPC raiders, their AI, and ramming
description:
Vessels study step S6 (`docs/ongoing-projects/vessels-ships.md`, Part 5 step 6; design in 3.3.8 and 1.6). The plan, interpretations, ablation, decisions made while building, and verification are in the "Phase 6 (S6) progress" section.

Review range: `vessels-s6-base..vessels-s6`. The MR !11 review fixes sit on top, in `vessels-s6..feat/vessels-s6`: the ram order is tied to its giver and consent is rechecked at the impact (`64c0b4884`), and the raider content rollback keeps a sailing raider's tier rows (`a6b17da0f`).

## What changes for players

- **Raiders.** A moving player's hull bigger than a boat, on open water with no lock set, is ambushed about once in 17 minutes of sailing (1 in 2002 ticks): twice as often in a pirate cove, half as often in territorial waters, and sixty times more rarely under neutral colors. Ships and transports are ambushed at most once a voyage. The hull's weight picks one of four raider tiers and a pirate or a hunter. The raider appears beyond sight off the bow and closes at full speed.
- **Raider AI** (Duris `NPCShipAI`). The basic brain turns the arc ready soonest onto the quarry and keeps within its weapons' band; the advanced brain projects both hulls 3 s ahead and works round to the quarry's weakest side with a broadside. Raiders fire as NPC return fire, ram when it pays, run when out of ammunition or holed, and board a slow quarry through the existing boarding contest. Pirates loot part of the hold and leave; hunters fight on. Killing the captain on her bridge stops her; the strongbox key is on the captain. A raider that loses her quarry leaves the sea 600 ticks later once nobody watches. Raiders cannot be claimed and never survive a restart.
- **NPC merchants** under fire now run from their attacker while returning fire, then resume their route.
- **Ramming.** `shipram [off]` braces the crew to ram the locked contact at speed 6 or more, with Duris's bow cone, chance, crash damage, fitted ram, knockdowns, and cooldowns. The sailmaster trains on every ram attempt.
- **Staff.** `vesseldebug raider <0-3> [hunter]` launches a raider against the player's hull you are aboard.

## Code and data

- New `src/vessels/vessels_raiders.c` and `src/vessels/vessels_ramming.c`, with `unittests/CuTest/test_vessel_raiders.c`.
- The hunter's pilot and retire helpers are shared as `vessel_assign_npc_pilot()` and `vessel_retire_npc_hull()`. The raider table and boot retirement run from the hunter lifecycle's schema and boot calls, so `boot_db()` is unchanged.
- Phase 22 SQL: `vessel_raider_tiers (tier, prototype_id)`, with rollback and verifier.
- Raider content: `sql/components/vessels_raider_content.sql` (six Corsair prototypes, not for sale, and ten tier rows, with rollback and verifier) and zone 700 mobiles 70020-70027 and objects 70020-70021 in `lib/world/vessel_raiders/`. `provision_vessel_harbor.sh` installs both on a development server. Production needs the SQL applied and the world records merged into its zone 700 files before any raider sails; until then an ambush comes to nothing.
- Help: SHIPFIRE (with SHIPRAM, RAMMING, and RAIDERS), SHIPEQUIP, and VESSELDEBUG, in `help.hlp` and `help_vessel_entries.sql`. The verifier checks 90 keywords and 34 content items.
- New live gate: `scripts/vessels/test_vessel_raider_in_game.sh`.

## Verification

- `make test-all` with the database cases on: 1,955 CuTest cases (11 new raider and ram tests) and the protocol harness.
- Phase 22 schema, rollback, and verifier, and the raider content, its rollback, and its verifier, on the test database. The content reapplies to the same six prototypes and ten tier rows.
- Vessel help verifier: 90 keywords, 34 content checks.
- All 18 live gates pass in the private namespace, the 17 existing ones and the new raider gate: harbor merchant, campaign, Vailand merchant, builder, gunnery, tactical, lookout, boarding, narrative, rules, events, movement, loss, damage, derelict, hunter, frontier, and raider.
  - In the raider gate, Kohdee's frigate rams a stopped warship at 99%. A Corsair raider closes from beyond sight in under two minutes, rams, and grapples, and her boarders are beaten off. With her captain purged she heaves to, and the restart retires her.
  - The raider gate passes again on the final build (133 s).
- Local CI (`scripts/ci/local/run.py --base gitlab/master`): all 33 jobs pass on `465a7c7e4`. That is the final code commit; only documentation follows it.
- Found and fixed along the way:
  - clang-tidy findings and a coverage floor on `boot_db()` (`39d2c4035`).
  - The raider gate read the restart log before boot had finished (`31f3045c1`).

Deferred to S7, as the study plans: the renown a raider carries, renown in the tier roll, and the neutral-colors sale penalty.
